integrity: A self-contained all-parameters proof gives both bounds separately in the binary and nonbinary cases. The supplied standard-library program exhaustively checks 7,210 geodesic vertex sets for ten finite graph cases; no independent external audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies to uniform Hamming graphs with integer dimension at least one and uniform alphabet size at least two; no mixed-alphabet or other graph-class formula is proved. Finite checks are not proofs of unrestricted cases. Historical completeness cannot be guaranteed.
title: Exact isometric-path complexity of Hamming graphs: a binary-alphabet threshold
